features.description: Repair application effect composition via the application-local equality solver. inferApp checkpoints, solves TypeEq/RowEq locally, substitutes funcNode/argNodes/resultType/argEffects/callee-effectRow BEFORE combineEffectList, and REPLACES (not deletes) solved equalities with flattened a~T forms in ctx.constraints. combineEffects stops dropping tails to nil. NO EffectJoin; row_unification.go unchanged. Files: typechecker_functions.go, typechecker_data.go, inference_helpers.go.
acceptance_criteria: AC1: inferApp checkpoints ctx.constraints, solves the application-subtree TypeEq/RowEq locally (reusing SolveConstraints' Unifier/RowUnifier), does NOT call whole-context SolveConstraints from inferApp
AC2: accumulated substitution applied to funcNode, argNodes, resultType, every argEffect, and callee effectRow before constructing TypedApp.EffectRow
AC3 REPLACE-NOT-DELETE: solved equalities REPLACED in ctx.constraints with flattened a~T forms (one per mapped var), NOT deleted; substituted class constraints retained
AC4: combineEffects never turns an unresolved tail into Tail:nil; unions closed rows directly, preserves one shared tail; budgets/params/provenance/deterministic ordering survive
AC5: two distinct unresolved tails after local solve = LOUD invariant failure (fail-closed), not a new row / not an implicit join

AC6 no-join structural proof: after inferApp, TypedApp.EffectRow is ordinary substituted *Row with <=1 tail; ctx.constraints has no deferred join and no un-replaced solved application equality; instrumented RowUnifier.UnifyRows sees only *Row; grep-assert no EffectJoin identifier exists

AC7 REPLACE-vs-DELETE fixture: a ModeCheck fixture where the fixed application is inside a let whose result must propagate to an OUTER node at the let boundary; PASSES under replace-not-delete, FAILS under a delete-based impl (asserts on the outer node's resolved type / downstream unify)

AC8: println(show(x)) and println(intToStr(x)) infer {IO} never {}; the unannotated-pure must-reject cases flip to correctly REJECTED with Missing effects: IO; control println(literal) rejection unchanged
row_unification.go diff is empty; effect_soundness_test.go (IO/FS/Env non-subsumption) stays green
